rule: For a stratum of quota q, cut [2015-01-01, 2026-11-01) UTC into q equal windows. In window i take category categories[i mod len(categories)] and query cat:C AND submittedDate:[midpoint TO window end] sorted by submittedDate ascending. The pick is the first result whose primary category is exactly C and which is not already picked. If the second half of the window has none, the same is done on the first half, sorted descending, from the midpoint backwards. No filter looks at anything but id, primary category and date. A pick that later proves unusable is recorded and never replaced. The version is the latest at selection time and is pinned.
